title: About Asset Management Property
meta_description: Company-owned overview migrated from the approved source assetmp.net.
content:
Asset Management Property describes itself on assetmp.net as one of the trusted providers of real estate services across Thailand.

The approved company-owned source states the business serves Pattaya, Bangkok, Phuket, Koh Samui, and Hua Hin, with more than nine years of dedicated industry experience across residences, condominiums, commercial investments, and holiday homes.

The same source highlights a multilingual team covering English, Chinese, Russian, German, Arabic, Dutch, and Thai, alongside services that include property investment, asset management, legal processes, and market analytics.

This record is a repo-backed baseline for runtime use and remains editable in admin for final editorial approval.

title: How We Work
meta_description: Current company workflow baseline for the A2 runtime.
content:
The approved company-owned source describes a hands-on approach that combines property scouting, legal due diligence, negotiation support, and after-sales service.

In the current A2 runtime, the workflow starts with purpose, budget range, and timeline. The team reviews the request against published inventory, responds with the clearest next step, and continues through consultation and follow-up.

This baseline is kept factual to both the company-owned source and the runtime implementation, and remains editable in admin for final editorial approval.

title: Privacy Policy
meta_description: Baseline privacy content migrated from the approved source assetmp.net.
content:
Effective date on the approved company-owned source: June 24, 2025.

Asset Management Property states that this privacy policy covers personal data collected when users interact with the website chat function. The source lists examples such as full name, email address, telephone number, and other information voluntarily disclosed during chat.

The same source states that session-based cookies may be used only to maintain conversation continuity and that no tracking or profiling cookies are used for marketing or behavioral analytics within that chat flow.

The company-owned policy states the data is used to respond to inquiries, facilitate communication, improve chat functionality and security, and comply with legal obligations. It also lists PDPA rights including access, rectification, deletion under certain conditions, objection or restriction, withdrawal of consent, and complaint rights.

Privacy contact on the approved source: dpo@assetmanagementproperty.co.th.

This record is a migrated legal baseline for runtime use and should still be reviewed in admin before final closure.
